kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنقسم (form VII)
# أَنْقَسِمُ (ʔanqasimu) /ʔan.qa.si.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# أَنْقَسِمَ (ʔanqasima) /ʔan.qa.si.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
# أَنْقَسِمْ (ʔanqasim) /ʔan.qa.sim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَسَمَ (inqasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
